name: Sunaga Midori
source:
Midori loves plants above all else — she can even hear the voice of flowers and other forms of vegetation. She spoils [url=/c98242]Kurumi[/url] and, despite her exasperation towards Kurumi's actions at times, she always accepts her in the end. Because there is only the two of them, she fears that the Gardening Club will go under eventually.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
